'''''Heuristic Financial Analysis''''' was a news publication that was active sometime around [[44 ABY]].<ref name="conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

During a mission to assassinate [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Querdan Dei]] posed as a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] employed by Heuristic Financial Analysis to infiltrate the makeshift camp on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] where the Queen Mother was visiting.<ref name="conviction" />
